description: Learns a global intensity threshold and an object scale from annotated training patches, then performs seeded instance segmentation on each test image independently. Training uses only pixels within the valid ROI (channel1==1) and ignores unknown labels (train_y<0). The global threshold is chosen by maximizing pixel-wise F1 on a coarse grid across evenly subsampled training patches. Object scale is estimated as the median GT instance area; from this we derive a seed separation (local-max window) and a mild Gaussian smoothing sigma. For each test image: (1) smooth intensity; (2) threshold to a foreground mask inside geometric extent (channel1>0.5); (3) detect local maxima above a stricter peak level (peak_rel=max(thr+0.1, thr*1.15), clipped to 0.95) with non-maximum suppression window based on learned scale; (4) ensure at least one seed per connected foreground component by adding the brightest pixel if needed; (5) assign every foreground pixel to its nearest seed via an EDT-based Voronoi within the mask (watershed-equivalent over distance to seeds); (6) remove instances with area<4 pixels and relabel consecutively. Pixels outside the test extent mask are set to background 0. Each test image is processed separately; no attempt is made to reconcile labels across images or patches. Deterministic, single-thread friendly, uses only numpy/scipy.
